meta.name: aed:availability
meta.description: Optional. URL to a JSON file matching the inline schema below. If set, the addon fetches state from this URL instead of reading the inline block — useful for backend-driven updates without rebuild.

json.description: Inline state for every <div data-aed-availability> on the page. Use this OR the meta-fetched JSON, not both. Omit entirely to silently hide every availability slot.

status.description: Drives the dot color and ARIA label.

text.description: Headline copy. Supports **bold** via Markdown-style **emphasis** (e.g. '**3 spots remaining** for May launches').

footnote.description: Small print under the headline (e.g. 'Updated April 19, 2026').
